parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
Input limits:

- Image format: JPG, PNG, or BMP.
- Image size: Less than 3 MB.
- Image resolution: Greater than 64 × 64 pixels and less than 3840 × 2160 pixels. The shortest side must be less than 2160 pixels and the longest side must be less than 3840 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The rendering intent mode. Valid values: LogC, Rec709, and ln17_256.

- LogC: suitable for gray footage (low-contrast raw images) input. Significantly adjusts the image color appearance to restore SDR-domain color quality.
- Rec709: suitable for images captured under normal conditions. Moderately enhances image brightness and saturation with conservative adjustments.
- ln17_256: suitable for images captured under normal conditions. Significantly adjusts image brightness, saturation, and contrast to enhance color quality.

parameters.name: OutputFormat
parameters.description: The format of the output image. Valid values: `png`, `jpg`, and `bmp`.
